title: Gold Rate Today November 19: Check latest Gold prices in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine

Gold prices in India today were ₹12,060 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (down by ₹235) and ₹96,480 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (down by ₹1,880). | Photo Credit: istock.com

Gold prices declined across most metro cities today compared to yesterday. Below is a detailed breakdown of gold prices in these cities.
